web_search.title: Search the web
web_search.description: Search the web with Bocha (strong on Chinese-language sources) and get ranked pages with title, url, snippet, optional long summary, site name, icon and publish date, plus related images. The response follows Bing's Web Search shape. Use this for plain result lists; use ai_search when you also want vertical structured cards (weather, stocks, trains...) or an LLM answer.

query.description: The search terms or natural-language question.

freshness.description: Time range: noLimit (default, recommended - Bocha rewrites time ranges itself), oneDay, oneWeek, oneMonth, oneYear, a single date YYYY-MM-DD, or a range YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. A narrow range can return nothing.

summary.description: Include each page's longer text summary alongside the short snippet.

include.description: Only search these sites: root or sub domains separated by | or , (max 100), e.g. qq.com|m.163.com.

exclude.description: Never return these sites: root or sub domains separated by | or , (max 100).

count.description: Results per page, 1-50 (default 10). Fewer may come back.

page.description: 1-based page of results, for fetching beyond the first count results.

output.description: The search response under `data`: queryContext.originalQuery, webPages.value (each with name, url, snippet, summary, siteName, siteIcon, datePublished) and images.value.

webPages.description: totalEstimatedMatches and value, the list of result pages.

images.description: value, images found on the result pages (contentUrl, hostPageUrl, width, height).

ai_search.title: AI search with answer and cards
ai_search.description: Run Bocha AI Search (non-streaming): searches the web, adds vertical structured 'modal cards' (weather, baike, medical, calendar, train, horoscope, gold, exchange rate, oil, phone, stock, car) and optionally an LLM-written answer with follow-up questions. Returns a list of messages whose `content` is often a JSON-encoded string. Use web_search for a cheaper plain result list.

query.description: What to search for or the question to answer. `site:qq.com|m.163.com ...` also restricts sites.

freshness.description: Time range: noLimit (default), oneDay, oneWeek, oneMonth or oneYear.

include.description: Only search these sites: domains separated by | or , (max 20).

count.description: Reference web pages to return, up to 50 (default 10).

answer.description: Have the LLM write a summary answer and follow-up questions (Bocha's default is true). False returns only sources and cards.

output.description: The `messages` list: each has role, type (source, answer, follow_up) and content_type (webpage, image, video, a modal-card type, or text); `content` holds the payload, JSON-encoded for sources and cards.

agent_search.title: Ask a Bocha vertical agent
agent_search.description: Call one of Bocha's vertical search agents (restaurants, hotels, attractions, train or flight tickets, companies, scholar, wenku documents) with a natural-language or keyword query and get its structured results as messages. Agent Search is a closed beta that needs the API key whitelisted by Bocha; for everything else use ai_search or web_search.
agent_search.notes: Bocha has stopped inviting new users to the Agent Search beta; keys that are not whitelisted get an error.

query.description: The request, e.g. 'ramen restaurants near Longhu Xixi Tianjie, Hangzhou'.

search_type.description: neural (default): Bocha extracts parameters from the natural-language query. keyword: the query is used as keywords and `parameters` must be given.

parameters.description: Extra agent-specific parameters that narrow the search; required when search_type is keyword.

output.description: The agent's `messages`: each has role, type and content_type (e.g. restaurant, hotel), with the results JSON-encoded in `content`.

rerank_documents.title: Rerank documents by relevance
rerank_documents.description: Score a list of text documents against a query with Bocha's semantic reranker and return them ordered by relevance_score (0-1), with each result's original index. Use it to reorder search results or RAG chunks before passing the best few to a model; it does not search.

query.description: The query the documents are ranked against.

model.description: Reranker model: gte-rerank, bocha-semantic-reranker-cn or bocha-semantic-reranker-en.

top_n.description: Return only the best N documents (at most the number of documents).

return_documents.description: Echo each document's text in the results.

output.description: Under `data`: model and results, each with index (position in the input list), relevance_score and, when asked, document.text.

get_remaining_balance.title: Get remaining account balance
get_remaining_balance.description: Read the prepaid balance left on the Bocha account behind this API key (in CNY). Check it when calls start failing with 403 'You do not have enough money', or before a large batch of searches.
